notes.title: 02/11Update
notes.notes:
We have adjusted the values and made some changes to the game system.
You can update by uninstalling the app and then installing it again.

notes.title: Announcement of "Killer Vegetable" remake decision
notes.notes:
In deciding to remake "KillerVegetable", we have decided to stop distributing KillerVegetable, which is currently being distributed. We are planning to renew it and further increase the power. We apologize for the inconvenience.
Cute vegetables! I'll make it even cooler next time, so look forward to it!
The release date of the remake is currently undecided.

Note: Additional information from 02/11.
The plan was to "stop" the distribution of the old version due to the remake, but it has been changed to "continue" the distribution.
